comments.author: @USMA88NTTG
comments.text:
Thank you for this video.  

As a retired U.S. GenXer, husband of decades, father, brother, and friend to others: 

On behalf of my parents, wife, and kids—thank God Almighty my parents pushed me toward baseball/track and field—and did not allow me to play ANY football at 6 yrs of age.  I wanted to play—but my parents made a good decision. 

I played baseball and ran track/field through college and into my 40s. 

Today I am mentally and physically sharp and healthy at 60yrs of age—per physical and neurological examination. 

Thankful to my parents! 

My close friends who played football at any level aged far worse—arthritis, obesity, back pain, shoulder pain, pain killer addiction, neurodegenerative disease, suicide, and poorer quality of life.  

Priorities I suppose—as the human body was not designed to run into other human bodies repeatedly at full speed. 

Good public service announcement.

There is no amount of money or fame that would lead me to recommend American football to any human.  

No way.  No how would I let my kid play American contact football even though I watch the sport.  

NOTE:  I understand why people play American football, but the human brain is literally trillions of nerves in dense jello surrounded by an unyielding bone skull—suspended with a thin film of fluid.
